ODPI-C 26.0.0 is now released. The major version number will now be the two digit year in which that version was first released. This release adds support for setting transaction priority and addresses a number of other issues.

See the [release notes](https://odpi-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releasenotes.html#version-26-0-0-september-10-2026) for more information.

ODPI-C 6.0.0 is now released. This release drops support for Oracle Client libraries before 19c and adds support for building with HP-UX aCC, setting and clearing application context entries, and providing the name of the pluggable database associated with a connection. A number of bugs were also fixed.

See the [release notes](https://odpi-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releasenotes.html#version-6-0-0-may-4-2026) for more information.
